I recently visited this PetSmart location and had a fairly average experience overall. The store was clean and reasonably well organized, making it easy to find most of the products I needed. There was a decent selection of pet food, treats, toys, and accessories for different types of pets, although a few items I was looking for were out of stock. It wasn’t a deal breaker, but it was a little disappointing.

The staff members were polite when I interacted with them, though they seemed busy and not always available to answer questions right away. Once I was able to get assistance, the employee was helpful and pointed me in the right direction. The checkout process was smooth, but there was a bit of a wait because only one register was open during a busy period.

The prices seemed comparable to other pet stores, and I appreciated the variety of products available. Some sale items offered good value, while other products felt a little expensive unless they were on promotion. The store itself was well maintained, and the aisles were wide enough to shop comfortably.

Overall, this was neither an outstanding nor a disappointing visit. The store met my basic expectations, but there is room for improvement, especially when it comes to keeping popular items in stock and having more staff available during peak hours. I would shop here again because it is convenient and generally reliable, but I hope future visits are a little more efficient and better stocked. It’s a solid option for routine pet supplies, even if it doesn’t always stand out from the competition

I am writing to express serious concern about the way birds are being cared for at your PetSmart location.

During my visit, I noticed that in several cages the water was extremely dirty, old, and stagnant. Even more concerning, in some cages the birds had no water available at all.

I visited the store twice on the same day — once in the morning and again in the evening — and the birds remained without water the entire time. When I asked the staff why the birds did not have access to water, I was told that the cages were in the process of being cleaned. However, it is not acceptable for cage cleaning to take place for the entire day while animals are left without water for more than six hours.

Access to clean drinking water is a basic necessity for any living animal. Leaving birds without water for extended periods of time raises serious concerns about their welfare.

Please look into this matter and take appropriate action to ensure that animals in your care are being treated according to proper standards.
